scenicChapters.title: Great Dolomites Road

legend-spreetshoogte-pass.slogan: Spreetshoogte Pass – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-spreetshoogte-pass.story: A gravel mountain pass from Solitaire, Namibia to Rehoboth area, Namibia, via Spreetshoogte viewpoint. Key character: Namib escarpment; steep descent; desert views. Surface: gravel.

scenicChapters.title: Spreetshoogte Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 15 km this is Spreetshoogte Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
